rationale: VERSION 1.3.0 -> 3.0.0: replaced ten clamped, alias, dead-texture, and degenerate controls with one exact returned-grid scene_profile axis.; Rebuilt generation around all four demonstrated 21x21 dense frame/noise profiles with exact count budgets, palette permutation, and randomized disjoint source/target placement.; Added strict ARC parsing, prefix-sum frame/slot classifiers, unique-largest and exactly-two-slot enforcement, a broad Python oracle, returned-grid observation, and RULE_HASH.; Bounded retries now fall back to a complete recolored public input profile rather than returning a partial scene; the fallback was unused in all 60,000 census draws.; Added focused mutation, determinism, source-sync, distribution, downstream, visual, and 497-case live-Racket evidence.
summary: Find every nonzero monochrome rectangular frame whose interior is all zero. Select the largest by bounding-box area. In row-major order, find the first other same-sized rectangle whose interior is all zero, and paint only that rectangle's border with the source frame color while preserving all other cells.
